content: Anatumi Wambu Rara Dupwa Kote Lara

content.text: Kamongome dopa letamo.
Yuu gii dokopa nambame wambu yuu Juta Jerusaleme range dupwa
bange ongore angerepe wakale wakale dupwa kamba mairunupa kapa rae maiyuo kararami.
Nambame wambu rara peparae nyuo pyasepala
yuu pau lama Jiyosapata lenge dokona lanyuo paro.
Yuu dokona nambana wambu range dupwa kando randa maiyakayami dokona
nakama kando kote laro.
Nakama Isaraele wambu dupwa yuu wakale dupwana nyuo nembapala
nambana yuu doko lili pyuo wakale wakale nakama nyiyami.
Nyepala nambana wambu dupwa kendemande yulu pyakamili lapala
kate pyuo bange wini pyuo nyingi dopale ingyuo wambu dupwa kate pipala mokwa soo nyuo
dee wane wanake dupwa nyepala ropo pyao maipala nakama kana nyiyaminyi dupwame
enda pamuku dupwa kana maiyuo nyuo ipwa waene ropo pyao nao piyami.

content: Yuu taone Taya Saitonepa dee Pilisitia range dupwa peparae namba kando apa pinya pilyamisi? Renge mende namba keta palipyasa dokona lao nakamame namba isingi yano pyamwali lao pilyamisi? Kinyi nakama renge mendena pirami ramo doko nambame waiya lao isingi yano pyakaro.
Nakamame nambana kana golope kana kulingipi dupwa nyimi dee nambana bange namba kamonganyi nembenge dupwa nyuo soo pao nakamana tembole anda dupwana reteyami.
Nakamame Juta wambu dupwape Jerusaleme wambu dupwape rangena yuu yaki nyepala nyuo yuu nanesa lanyuo pao Giriki wambu dupwa ropo pyao maiyami.
Epapu nambame yuu ropo pyao maiyaminyi petaminyi dupwa kaepala nakama nyisa nyuo lanyuo eparo. Dokopa nakamame nambana wambu randa maiyakayami dokona nambame dopako pyuo nakama randa jero.
Dopako pyuo nambame nakamana wane wanake dupwa Juta wambu dupwame ropo pyao nyinya laro. Nyepala nakamame dupwa Sapeyane wambu yuu nanesa range duwpa maipala bange nyerami. Kamongome dopa leya.

content.text: Pii dake rara peparae keta lamaipi.
Yanda pingi akali peparae mupwape meepe dupwa kee lao nyuo
sukusa sukusa pipala
yanda pirami dokona wato rapa rapa pipwape.
Nakamana ee yulu pyuo yuu apu renge ane isa dupwa kamame rakyuo wua gela waso
nakamana kema wua isa pyakepenge dupwa nyepala kaku waso pipwape.
Dopa pipala kamame akali kuki yanda pii nange dupwa pyuoko pirami.
Nakama rara awali lao palaminyi dupwa
waiya lao epo
yuu pau lama dokona malu palyuo pisipwape.
Dokopa Kamongo embena yanda pingi akali porai wakasa dupwa epena lare.
Rara dupwa peparae rapa rapa pipala
yuu Jiyosapata pau lama dokona eparami.
Yuu dokona namba Kamongo doko pisipala
rara peparae awali lao palu pelyaminyi dupwa kote laro.
Nakama ama koo andake pilyaminyi.
Dokona witi jingi wambu pilyamo pyakepo lyingi dopakale ingyuo
nakama pyao pyakepo
isa girapo jingi kalyuo pyaraku kingilyaminyi
waene ipwange epo soo simbuo penge dopale ingyuo
nakama kalyuo pyaraku piri.
Wambu taosande malu dupwa
yuu pau lama kote lara dokona karaminyi.
Yuu dokona Kamongona yuu gii doko repeta epara.
Neta kanapa dolapo iminjapyamopa bui dupwa rao kara nalyaminyi.

content: Juta Wambu Dupwa Elyape Keta Pisara

content.text: Kamongome dokome yuu kyau Sayone dokona pii poraiyuo lao
dee yuu gala lenge dopale ingyuo baame yuu Jerusaleme dokona pii lao piramopa
yake yuupi dupwa piku piku lala lala para.
Dopa piramopape baa rangeme banya wambu dupwa yaki nyii nao rapu pyuo karara.
Dokopa Isaraele wambu dupwame namba nakamana Kamongo Anatulyamo lao soo nyerami.
Yuu kyau yapasi Sayone lenge dokona namba palenge.
Dokopa yuu taone Jerusaleme doko poo pyasi ingyuo andake seramopa
wambu rara wakale dupwame kamba nyuo isa palya narami.
Yuu gii dokopa girapo isa dupwa
yuu kyau dupwana paeyo mee bange ingyuo andaramopa
mena dupwa yuu kyau peparaena buu minyuo kararaminyi kandarami.
Juta wambu dupwana ipwa epenge dupwana ipwa malu epara.
Kamongona tembole anda dokona piso ipwa mende guu lao jerae pyao lupyuo eparamo dokome
yuu Akasiya pau lama lama dokona isa andenge dupwa nenge pira.
Yuu Isipi wambupi yuu Itome wambupi dupwame
yuu Juta wambu anjiki pyuo kareyaminyi dupwa piyaminyi dokona
yuu Isipi doko muiyane ingyuo sinya lao
dee yuu Itome doko pyao kokwa soo momo nanyi nembo pira.
Nambame wambu pyao kumuyaminyi dupwana reke lao yano pyakamyuo nakama randa mairu.
Nambame wambu piyaminyi dupwa lete kara nana lao pyaro.
Dopa pirunupape yuu Juta Jerusalemepe dolapona wambu dupwa mende pii naramo mee palu karalu kararami.
Dokopa Kamongo doko yuu kyau Sayone dokona karara.
